title: Design System: Adrián de los Reyes

display.purpose: Hero headline, with responsive mobile scale.

motion.name: heading-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time bounded section-heading reveal at 12% intersection; underlying HTML remains visible without JavaScript.

motion.name: work-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time reveal of real linked work media.

motion.name: reading-rail
motion.purpose: Fixed noninteractive progress rail updated after scroll/resize/visibility events; hidden with reduced motion.

motion.name: experience-reading
motion.value: 600ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); 1px rule scaleX(0) → scaleX(1); title color 300ms
motion.purpose: Highlights the experience crossing the central reading zone; its date entrance is 500ms with 14px horizontal travel.

motion.name: work-unfold
motion.value: perspective(1100px); rotateX(phase × 3deg); rotateY(phase × -7deg); translateY(phase × 22px); pointer transition 350ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Nearby editorial screenshots unfold with natural scroll. Mouse contribution is ±2.5deg Y and ±1.5deg X; copy offsets up to 18px over 200ms ease-out. Mobile uses 2deg X and 12px vertical travel with stationary copy.

motion.name: gesture-pose
motion.value: joint interpolation 0.14/frame; rotation interpolation 0.1/frame; static SVG pose 550ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Illustrative 21-landmark hand with three keyboard-accessible pose buttons. Lazy desktop approach loading/mobile opt-in, pixel ratio ≤1.5, visible demand-driven rendering, static fallback on failure/context loss and live removal for reduced motion.

motion.name: demo-playback
motion.value: manual start; muted; playsInline; native controls; preload metadata after activation
motion.purpose: Real silent recordings use posters and pause offscreen or hidden, without automatic resumption. Original LinkedIn links and case context remain accessible without JavaScript.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: cancel animations; remove journey transforms; hide rail; disable gesture WebGL; CSS animation/transition none
motion.purpose: Live preference changes restore static reading and SVG poses. Explicit user-requested video playback remains available.

components.description: Visible navigation with identity and resume action.
components.html: ADR.ExperienceWorkContact
components.css: .ds-nav {display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;min-height:82px;color:var(--muted);font:400 14px var(--font-manrope),sans-serif;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);}.ds-nav a {color:inherit;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 0;}.ds-nav a:hover {color:var(--bone);}.ds-nav a:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:6px;}.ds-logo {font-size:27px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-right:auto;}.ds-logo span {color:var(--cyan);}

components.name: Layer controls
components.description: HTML controls remain independent of WebGL.
components.css: .ds-layers {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-block:1px solid var(--rule);}.ds-layers button {background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--muted);min-height:48px;padding:14px 8px;font:400 12px var(--font-manrope),sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-layers button[aria-pressed=true] {background:#12202b;color:var(--cyan);}.ds-layers button:hover {color:var(--bone);background:var(--raised);}.ds-layers button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:6px;}

components.name: Gesture pose controls
components.description: Three HTML buttons select illustrative hand poses; the snippet records their accessible control surface independently of WebGL.
components.css: .ds-gesture-controls {display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}.ds-gesture-controls button {border:1px solid var(--rule);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-radius:5px;padding:9px 13px;font:400 12px var(--font-manrope),sans-serif;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms,color 160ms;}.ds-gesture-controls button[aria-pressed=true] {border-color:var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan);color:var(--ink);}.ds-gesture-controls button:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]) {color:var(--bone);border-color:var(--muted);}.ds-gesture-controls button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:6px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-gesture-controls button {transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A dark engineering folio: a precise product system unfolds beside a clear personal introduction. The user selected the dark layered system, delegated the composition and approved implementation. Human-readable content remains the primary interface; the model makes backend, web and mobile relationships tangible.

Real work is presented through large screenshots, concise contribution statements and readable case studies. Identity is prominent and surfaces stay quiet. Motion now extends through the reading journey: experience rules, bounded heading reveals, unfolding shipped interfaces and illustrative gesture input. Silent project reels supply direct evidence of the experiments. The final build, rather than a generated screen or an earlier seed, defines the tokens below.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink, bone text, cyan actions and a restrained copper accent.
Manrope for identity and reading; IBM Plex Mono only for technical data.
Editorial screenshots, quiet dividers and a countable layered system.
Responsive natural scrolling, bounded motion and accessible HTML controls.
Manual silent demos with original LinkedIn posts beside the project context.
dos: Do use real screenshots and verified professional claims.
Do preserve equivalent Spanish and English content and working localized routes.
Do keep text and controls usable with reduced motion, no JavaScript or unavailable WebGL.
Do place project category and code visibility after the heading and summary.
Do start silent demos manually and retain native playback controls and original post links.
donts: Don’t add eyebrows, decorative particles, gradient text or glass panels.
Don’t use fictional screens, invented metrics or inaccessible private repository links.
Don’t make navigation depend on the 3D scene.
Don’t record the 70.3% image comparison as an automatic fidelity pass.
